run_detail.final_report_title: 研究报告：Rust 2024 edition 相对 2021 edition 有哪些不兼容变更？引用 Rust 官方 edition 指南。
run_detail.final_report_markdown:
# Rust 2024 edition 相对 2021 edition 的不兼容变更：基于官方 edition 指南的梳理 本次核验的资料显示，2024 edition 可以包含不兼容变更，例如引入与代码中标识符冲突的新关键字；同时，edition 机制本身以选择性迁移为前提，不兼容变更被推入下一个 edition，现有代码除非显式迁移否则不会使用这些变更，而迁移可借助 cargo fix 自动完成。关于具体不兼容变更的细目，资料仅明确提到 `#"hey"#` 这类词法形式在 2021 被接受、在 2024 为 hard error，以及 Cargo 与 rustfmt 等工具层面也会被纳入 edition 相关变更的考虑。 ## 直接回答 本次核验的资料显示，edition 可以承载不兼容变更，典型例子是引入与代码中标识符冲突的新关键字，因此 2024 edition 相对 2021 edition 在语言层面可能带来需要迁移调整的写法。与此同时，这类变更并非只限于语言本身，Cargo 和 rustfmt 的变化同样会被纳入 edition 相关变更的考虑范围。 [evidence:ea0f50f866f149b41f0953400cdcd108584e49bc70aa79b5] [evidence:3ea19d415f97e3bb199b48bae56e60eada5f56e0c1d0937e] 在词法解析方面，资料给出的具体案例是 `#"hey"#`：它在当前 edition（Rust 2021）中被接受，但在 Rust 2024 中是 hard error。这说明部分在 2021 下合法的写法在 2024 中会被拒绝，需要相应调整。 [evidence:0a74574a616fbe1376acef234e5b484a63eb0811528c20e3] 不兼容变更的落地方式与 edition 的可选性直接相关：变更被推入下一个 edition，而 edition 是 opt-in 的，现有 crate 除非显式迁移，否则不会使用这些变更。为帮助过渡，Cargo 提供 `cargo fix` 子命令自动更新源代码；若某些问题无法自动修复，`cargo fix` 会在控制台打印无法修复的警告，此时需要手动更新代码。2024 edition 的相关指引同样说明可通过 `cargo fix` 自动升级代码。 [evidence:19e00485f4eb41f013664fab95b7e8b499fa20d3a45c9f32] [evidence:2e42ef789f20480f4555f3aaa7790f86731fee379a1d5db5] [evidence:04a621f478d6de572de87eddd3b3e4ed6d685e181957428a] [evidence:a13be51325279c97cf8996f11a78e5d1b63c1b1c6544e1d6] [evidence:09e9eb2775862338a5dc0fdb3c3987ae7145ca5f2b5167eb] ## 对比表 | 主题 | Rust 2021 edition | Rust 2024 edition | | --- | --- | --- | | 不兼容变更的性质 | 资料未直接描述 | edition 可包含不兼容变更，例如引入与代码中标识符冲突的新关键字 [evidence:ea0f50f866f149b41f0953400cdcd108584e49bc70aa79b5] | | 词法解析 `#"hey"#` | 被接受 | hard error [evidence:0a74574a616fbe1376acef234e5b484a63eb0811528c20e3] | | 受影响范围 | 资料未直接描述 | 不只限于语言本身，Cargo 与 rustfmt 的变化也在考虑范围内 [evidence:3ea19d415f97e3bb199b48bae56e60eada5f56e0c1d0937e] | | 迁移与兼容指引 | 不兼容变更推入下一个 edition；edition 为 opt-in，现有 crate 除非显式迁移否则不受影响；`cargo fix` 自动更新代码，无法修复时打印警告并需手动更新 | 可通过 `cargo fix` 自动升级代码到新 edition [evidence:19e00485f4eb41f013664fab95b7e8b499fa20d3a45c9f32] [evidence:2e42ef789f20480f4555f3aaa7790f86731fee379a1d5db5] [evidence:04a621f478d6de572de87eddd3b3e4ed6d685e181957428a] [evidence:a13be51325279c97cf8996f11a78e5d1b63c1b1c6544e1d6] [evidence:09e9eb2775862338a5dc0fdb3c3987ae7145ca5f2b5167eb] | ## Citation audit ### Rust 2021 edition · Migration and compatibility guidance - Evidence: `evidence:19e00485f4eb41f013664fab95b7e8b499fa20d3a45c9f32` - Exact quote: “When there are backwards-incompatible changes, they are pushed into the next edition. Since editions are opt-in, existing crates won’t use the changes unless they explicitly migrate into the new edition.” - Snapshot: `research/external/9f0fc2df-ff82-4bf5-82dd-0171905439f9/a06396c91394fbfef444cd9d344b37e45c718e2e9162b113370fbe3bde70f6a9` - URL: https://doc.rust-lang.org/edition-guide/editions/ ### Rust 2021 edition · Affected language areas - Evidence: `evidence:0a74574a616fbe1376acef234e5b484a63eb0811528c20e3` - Exact quote: “this is accepted in the current edition (Rust 2021) but is a hard error in Rust 2024!” - Snapshot: `research/external/9f0fc2df-ff82-4bf5-82dd-0171905439f9/00d5c5adb62f4408fcb2c000bacd6ab10e9102f312e1ee3c80a2283c3220bf17` - URL: https://doc.rust-lang.org/rustc/lints/listing/allowed-by-default.html ### Rust 2024 edition · Migration and compatibility guidance - Evidence: `evidence:09e9eb2775862338a5dc0fdb3c3987ae7145ca5f2b5167eb` - Exact quote: “explains how to automatically upgrade your code to a new edition via `cargo fix`.” - Snapshot: `research/external/9a6de107-631e-490f-86da-36e5fba4e076/fd50cd1493d64499d817e9ca2eeee0c8e32be7f9233bb87b03ebbe10e3cd80f8` - URL: https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/appendix-05-editions.html ### Rust 2024 edition · Incompatible breaking changes - Evidence: `evidence:ea0f50f866f149b41f0953400cdcd108584e49bc70aa79b5` - Exact quote: “Editions can contain incompatible changes, such as including a new keyword that conflicts with identifiers in code.” - Snapshot: `research/external/9a6de107-631e-490f-86da-36e5fba4e076/fd50cd1493d64499d817e9ca2eeee0c8e32be7f9233bb87b03ebbe10e3cd80f8` - URL: https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/appendix-05-editions.html ### Rust 2024 edition · Affected language areas - Evidence: `evidence:3ea19d415f97e3bb199b48bae56e60eada5f56e0c1d0937e` - Exact quote: “Also note that potential Edition-related changes aren't just limited to the language itself:
we'll also consider changes to both Cargo and rustfmt as well.” - Snapshot: `research/external/2ea0eb63-1df4-4ef5-9587-d3127d18d7eb/abfa7d6c74fa9f6c9520f9f7a061659da283186fe43386568ae2192869952da1` - URL: https://blog.rust-lang.org/2023/12/15/2024-Edition-CFP/ ## 补充引用 - Evidence: `evidence:2e42ef789f20480f4555f3aaa7790f86731fee379a1d5db5` - Exact quote: “In order to help transition to the next edition, Cargo includes the [`cargo fix`](../../cargo/commands/cargo-fix.html) subcommand to automatically update your source code.” - Snapshot: `research/external/9f0fc2df-ff82-4bf5-82dd-0171905439f9/36195c6194c6bfa26e6326dc8b31140facb8d090e52e568ca2c7ca513cf8f935` - URL: https://doc.rust-lang.org/edition-guide/editions/transitioning-an-existing-project-to-a-new-edition.html - Evidence: `evidence:04a621f478d6de572de87eddd3b3e4ed6d685e181957428a` - Exact quote: “If `cargo fix` can’t fix something, it will print the warning that it cannot fix to the console.
